title: TypeScript Error Cleanup — Engine-Rename Migration Completion
rationale: Esbuild compiles fine (build:fast works, tests pass via tsx loader), but tsc --noEmit fails. The errors are concentrated in dispatcher case statements that reference engines from a partial rename migration: 30+ engines were renamed and/or restructured but the dispatcher cases were never updated. Fixing requires API reconciliation, not just import-path edits.

tasks: U-CL01: Sweep TS2305 unused-import errors across all dispatchers (~17 cases). camDispatcher.ts U-TSC-CLEANUP-01 already done — pattern proven.

U-CL02: Re-export shims for the 3 confirmed renames (MaterialDatabaseEngine -> Bridge, CAMDeepLearningEngine -> Mastercam, ControllerKnowledgeEngine -> DB) WITH compat method delegation. Adds ~15 small shim files.
U-CL03: Drop dispatcher cases pointing at engines that genuinely don't exist (verify each via duplicationGuardEngine first). May be ~25 cases.

phases.phase: P2 — Engine API reconciliation (target ~400 errors / 3-5 days)
tasks: U-CL04: TS2339 cluster (282 errors) — for each property-not-found error, decide: add the property to the engine, or rewrite the call. Group by engine, fix all calls together.
U-CL05: TS2554 + TS2345 cluster (153 errors) — engine method signature drift. Update callers to match current signatures.
U-CL06: TS18048 cluster (33 errors) — undefined-handling. Add narrowing guards or default values.

phases.phase: P3 — Schema shape drift (target ~210 errors / 2 days)
tasks: U-CL07: TS2353 cluster (68 errors) — Zod schemas allow excess properties that runtime payloads don't have. Either tighten the schemas or use .passthrough().
U-CL08: TS2322 cluster (142 errors) — type assignment shape mismatches. Often Dirent<string> vs Dirent<NonSharedBuffer> (Node 22 type widening). Add explicit type annotations to readdirSync calls.
U-CL09: Remaining TS2739 (20), TS2305 (17), TS2484 (15) and tail of long-tail codes.
U-CL10: Re-run audit; commit baseline if anything still genuinely needs deferral.

agents.task: For each phase, decide: fix-in-place vs delete vs migrate. Produce per-task batched fix list.
Apply fixes. Confirm no test regressions per batch.
After each batch, verify error count dropped + no semantic regression in dispatcher routing behavior.

guardrails: Worktree-isolated branch (`work/tsc-cleanup-ms0`) — must not conflict with active feature branches.
Run `npx vitest run` after each phase; total tests must not drop.
Do NOT delete engines based on tsc errors alone — confirm via grep across .claude/commands and dispatchers that they're truly unused.
Per-batch commits with `[MAIN] TSC-CLEANUP-MS0/U-CL##: <description>` so reverts are surgical.
scrutinize-before-stop gate already enforces parallel-agent review per stop.
launch_command: /team-dispatch architect+implementer+reviewer with brief='Execute TSC-CLEANUP-MS0 phase 1 — see mcp-server/data/milestones/TSC-CLEANUP-MS0.json'
